findings.highlight: And so we climb the stone steps.
findings.evidenceJa: 赤い光が、山頂を包み込んでいる。
findings.governingReading: The active Japanese says red light surrounds the summit and the strengthening wind appears to originate in that light at the rear of the precinct.
findings.explanation: Red summit light and strengthening wind become climbing steps and thickening air.

findings.highlight: It's what spilled onto me ten years ago."
findings.evidenceJa: —十年前、おまえが我に浴びせたモノだ」
findings.governingReading: Addressing Saber, Gilgamesh says this is what she showered him with ten years earlier.
findings.explanation: Gilgamesh directly attributes his exposure to Saber. The English describes a spill without saying she caused it.

findings.governingReading: Kirei finishes his taunt and Shirou makes a quoted startled response.
findings.explanation: The speaker change loses quotation boundaries.

findings.governingReading: He hears the ground being burned, then identifies steaming black mud.
findings.explanation: Burning sound becomes an asserted fire on the ground.

findings.highlight: The dark mud spreading over the lake is steaming.
findings.evidenceJa: じゅうじゅうと湯気を立てているのは、池から伸びてきた黒い泥だった。
findings.governingReading: It has extended out from the pool into his ground-level route.
findings.explanation: Mud coming from the pool becomes mud spreading over it.

findings.highlight: It follows no matter how far I retreat, and it's not the only one.
findings.evidenceJa: その気になれば何処まで退いても追ってくるだろうし、その数だって、一本だけという事もあるまい—
findings.governingReading: If it chose to pursue, it would probably follow any retreat, and he expects there is more than one.
findings.explanation: Conditional pursuit and expected number become present unqualified facts.

findings.highlight: I can't feel my mud-coated right ankle, and I wasn't entirely sure I even still had my right leg until I used it to leap away.
findings.evidenceJa: 粘液が張り付いた右の足首は感覚がなく、カカトから先がくっついているかさえ判らなかったが、ともかく目前の空き地へ飛び込んだ。
findings.governingReading: His right ankle is numb and he cannot tell whether the part forward of the heel remains attached; he jumps anyway, then explicitly checks.
findings.explanation: The uncertain foot becomes a missing leg supposedly disproved by a leap.

findings.highlight: The scent of burning earth wakes my dizzy head, and I push myself back up to my feet.
findings.evidenceJa: 地面を焼く匂いで目眩を起こす頭をしぼって、立ち上がって、それから—
findings.governingReading: He strains his head made dizzy by the burning-ground smell in order to rise.
findings.explanation: The odor causing dizziness becomes an odor waking him.

findings.highlight: There's not enough time for me to hold back about using Projection; it's my only hope.
findings.evidenceJa: ……頼みの綱の“投影”も、出し惜しみなんてしていない。
findings.governingReading: He says his failure to use the last resort is not saving it for later; the lack of concentration time explains the barrier.
findings.explanation: Denial of conserving Projection becomes a call not to hold back.

findings.highlight: A tidal wave of mud crashes over me.
findings.evidenceJa: 止まる事など許さない、と無数の泥が振り下ろされた。
findings.governingReading: The many masses swing downward and he narrowly avoids them next.
findings.explanation: Incoming mud becomes a wave crashing over him before he dodges.
